basic_details.short_information: Maritime Training Institute (MTI), Powai, Mumbai has invited applications for empanelment of 37 faculty and instructors across 16 posts: 4 on full-time contract basis (₹1,50,000 per month lumpsum for full-time contract faculty) and 33 on visiting basis (as and when required). Empanelment is for two years. Applications go to the Principal, MTI by hand or by email and must be submitted on or before 07 December 2026, 1700 hrs. Interviews are tentatively scheduled for 14 to 16 December 2026.

how_to_apply: Applications are accepted offline: interested candidates may submit a physical application to the Principal at the address below, or send an email to the Principal, MTI. The application must be in the Application Format printed on pages 7 and 8 of the notice, stating whether it is for full time contract basis, visiting basis or both. Applications should be submitted on or before 07 December 2026, 1700 hrs.
Address: The Principal, Maritime Training Institute, 52-C, Adi Shankaracharya Marg, Powai, Mumbai - 400 072.
Enclose copies in support of essential qualification, experience, proof of date of birth, COC, INDOS and TOTA/VICT/TOTI certificate.
Candidates above 65 years of age must also submit a medical certificate from a DGS certified medical practitioner as per DGS guidelines.
Do not leave any space of the application format blank.

Selection contains only an interview. Candidates found eligible as per the criteria will be considered, and shortlisted candidates will be called for physical personal interviews at the Maritime Training Institute, 52-C, Adi Shankaracharya Marg, Powai, Mumbai - 400 072. The time and date will be intimated only to shortlisted candidates by e-mail. The notice gives tentative interview dates of 14 to 16 December 2026. Candidates must make their own arrangements for stay in Mumbai and no travelling allowance is paid. On special requests, an online interview may be considered for candidates on prior intimation.
Post applied for, full name, date of birth and age as on 01/11/2026.
Permanent address, address for communication, telephone, mobile and e-mail.
Educational and professional qualification, Certificate of Competency (date and place of issue) and total experience.
Details of VICT/TOTA, AECS and TSTA certificates, a reference person with mobile number, and disclosure of relatives working in SCI.
Particulars of experience (latest first), teaching experience, a recent passport size photograph with signature across it, and the applicant's declaration, place, date and signature.
important_instructions: This requirement is purely on Contract/Visiting basis and will not lead to any permanent employment with Maritime Training Institute. Canvassing in any form may attract disqualification. MTI, Powai reserves the right to accept or reject any application, and the decision of the Institute will be final and binding. There is no hours guarantee for the Visiting Faculty and Instructors. As per DGMA Guidelines, a yearly Fitness Certificate from a DG Certified Medical Practitioner is mandatory for Visiting Faculties attaining age of 65 years and above. Accommodation is not provided (NA in the terms table).

content_sections.heading: About MTI
content_sections.text: Maritime Training Institute (MTI), Powai is a training institute established by The Shipping Corporation of India Limited (SCI) and owned by Shipping Corporation of India Land and Assets Limited (SCILAL). This invitation is for faculty and instructors for Nautical and Marine Engineering subjects and courses. The notice describes visiting basis as "as and when required".

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice lists 37 vacancies in total: 04 on full-time contract basis and 33 on visiting basis. The notice states that the qualification of faculty and instructors is the same whether the empanelment is full-time contract or visiting. No category-wise reservation is printed.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: Nautical Faculty: faculty with 2 Years of experience of teaching/training for Chief Mates, Masters COC courses, VICT/TOTA, TSTA, AECS Certified and Simulator courses, viz. as ROC, ARPA, ECDIS, etc. Nautical Faculty Passenger Ship: faculty with 2 Years of experience of teaching/training for Chief Mate, Master COC course, VICT/TOTA, AECS, TSTA and Simulator courses, viz. as ROC, ARPA, ECDIS, etc. Marine Engineering Faculty: faculty with experience of teaching/training for GME, Class-IV MEO, Class-I & II MEO COC courses and courses, viz. as LNG, TASCO, GASCO etc. Radio Officer (GMDSS) Faculty: candidates with Indian COP II Class or ROGC & VICT/TOTA, TSTA. Naval Architect: experience in Ship building; VICT or TOTA Certification will be preferred. Medical Instructor: candidates having experience in training institute. Hostel Warden (Male) and (Female): candidates having experience in training institute and ex-armed forces. Physical Training Instructor: ex-armed forces APTC. Swimming Pool Instructor: candidates having work experience in Wet Drill Activity in Training Institute and Life Raft Servicing. Yoga Trainer: for Pre-sea and Post-sea Courses for compliance of Sagar Mein Yog Programme vide DGS Circular No.48 of 2025 dated 06.11.2025. The experience requirement is to be met as on 01.09.2026. Faculty members having teaching experience of Mates, Chief Engineers and Masters COC courses and hands-on knowledge of Simulators will be given preference. TSTA is desirable. Preference will be given to applicants for faculties below 65 years of age, and with teaching experience in similar Maritime Training Institutes. Applicants should possess the DG Shipping approved certificate of Vertical Integration Course for Trainers (VICT), erstwhile known as Training for Trainers and Assessors (TOTA) / Training for Trainers and Instructors (TOTI). For each of the three, the applicant should be physically and mentally fit for carrying out the duties as required. The notice does not print a separate age line for Hostel Warden or Yoga Trainer, and prints no age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: In the absence of a hostel warden, a Visiting Faculty or Instructor who undertakes the hostel warden job will be compensated with ₹ 1,400/- for minimum 08 hours (same remuneration as a Visiting Instructor). Honorarium rates are subject to change at the discretion of Maritime Training Institute, Powai. The notice does not print separate pay for the Hostel Warden, Medical Instructor, Physical Training Instructor, Swimming Pool Instructor, Workshop Instructor, Electro Technical/Electrical Officer and Naval Architect posts. The empanelment period is two years only and extension will not be granted. Empanelment does not confer any right to regular employment in SCI/MTI, and engagement is governed by the terms and conditions in the Empanelment/Offer Letter. Other terms and conditions for both full-time contract and visiting basis, as well as reporting details, will be laid out in the Empanelment Letter / Offer Letter given to selected applicants.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in MTI Powai Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 37 vacancies across 16 posts: 04 on full-time contract basis and 33 on visiting basis (as and when required).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for MTI Powai faculty and instructor posts?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted on or before 07 December 2026, 1700 hrs. The interviews are tentatively scheduled for 14 to 16 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Nautical Faculty at MTI Powai?
faq.answer: Nautical Faculty must hold a COC of Master Mariner (Foreign Going Ship) issued by DGMA, with sailing experience on merchant ships as a management officer for a total of 7 years or more and at least 2 years of Command experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for MTI Powai recruitment?
faq.answer: As on 1 November 2026, the age should not be more than 70 years for visiting faculty, 68 years for full time contract faculty and 63 years for instructors.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of full-time contract faculty at MTI Powai?
faq.answer: Full time contract faculty receive ₹ 1,50,000/- per month (lumpsum), with TDS as per Income Tax Dept. Guidelines. No other perks, allowances or conveyance are paid extra.

faq.question: Q6. How much honorarium do visiting faculty get at MTI Powai?
faq.answer: Visiting Faculty for Master Mariners/Chief Engineers get ₹ 1,400/- per hour plus ₹ 500/- per day conveyance. Radio Officer (GMDSS) Visiting Faculty get ₹ 1,250/- per hour, and Subject Matter Experts ₹ 1,000/- per hour, each with ₹ 500/- per day conveyance.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for MTI Powai faculty posts?
faq.answer: Submit a physical application in the prescribed format to The Principal, Maritime Training Institute, 52-C, Adi Shankaracharya Marg, Powai, Mumbai - 400 072, or email it to [email protected] with the copies of certificates named in the notice.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for MTI Powai recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process contains only an interview. Shortlisted candidates are called for a physical personal interview at MTI, Powai, and are informed of the date and time by e-mail.

faq.question: Q9. Is the MTI Powai job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The requirement is purely on Contract/Visiting basis, empanelment is for two years only without extension, and it does not lead to permanent employment with MTI.

faq.question: Q10. Is travelling allowance paid for the MTI Powai interview?
faq.answer: No travelling allowance is paid and candidates arrange their own stay in Mumbai. An online interview may be considered on special request with prior intimation.
